chapter_outcomes: Main types of tourism: Domestic, Inbound, Outbound, International, Day trip, Short break

Main reasons why people travel: Leisure, Business (MICE – Meetings, Incentives, Conventions and Exhibitions), VFR – visiting friends and relatives, Special interest, e.g. medical, religious, adventure, cultural, sports, health and wellbeing
Sustainable travel and tourism: Sustainability, Sustainable travel and tourism, Ecotourism, Responsible tourism
Characteristics of travel and tourism: Products, Services, Intangible, Perishable, Seasonal, Dynamic, Increasingly sustainable, Resilient
Types of tourists: Business, Couples, Ecotourists, Families, Groups, Independent, Individuals, Leisure, Responsible tourists, Special interest, Specific needs
Types of destinations: Beach/coastal, Island, Resort, e.g. purpose-built, integrated, ski, eco, Rural, e.g. countryside, mountains, lakes, Urban, e.g. town, city
